summary: Thomson Reuters filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release and report on voting results from its annual meeting of shareholders held June 10, 2026. All 14 director nominees were elected with high vote percentages, and other routine items were voted on including auditor reappointment, advisory compensation resolution, and a shareholder proposal. This is a routine reporting of annual meeting outcomes without any special situation event such as acquisitions, divestitures, management upheaval, or strategic changes.
